title: ASUS Business Manager Service Client-Side Authentication Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of ASUS Business Manager. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ASUS Business Manager Service. The issue results from the use of client-side authentication. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.
